db_note: TWO STACKED BUGS, both fixed in source 2026-09-22, container NOT yet rebuilt. (1) config.py read env_prefix=MEMCORE_ while docker-compose.yml sets MNEM_*, so MNEM_DATA_DIR=/data was ignored outright. (2) db_path/key_path/vector_path were declared at class scope as `data_dir / "..."`, which pydantic evaluates once against the DEFAULT data_dir - so fixing the prefix alone still left every derived path under ~/.memcore. Both fixed; paths now resolve via a model_validator. The named volume is currently EMPTY and the live container still writes to /root/.memcore. db_host_cli_copy is a third, separate store used only by the host CLI. See CLAUDE.md 'Known issues'.
key_destruction_note: CRITICAL, fixed 2026-09-22. KeyManager.load_or_create branched on `st_size > 100`, so a raw 32-byte unprotected key never matched the load path and was OVERWRITTEN with a fresh key on every open. It fired on this container at 23:40:47 UTC 2026-09-21 during an audit `docker exec`. The REST process kept working from its in-memory key while its own DB became undecryptable on disk. Data fully recovered (only content+metadata are encrypted; id/tier/timestamp/forgetting_json/entities_json/embedding are plaintext columns) into db_recovered. Deploy from db_recovered, NOT from the container's writable layer.
deploy_warning: Do not restart or recreate the mnemosyne container before staging db_recovered into the volume - its in-memory key is the only thing that can still read its own database.
bridge_note: Windows-only file, not reachable/verifiable from this SkyNAS session
local_mcp: .mcp.json in the project root - bridge mode: `server mcp --remote http://192.168.1.183:8000`
local_mcp_note: mcp/server.py was rewritten onto the official MCP SDK (mcp 2.2.0). It previously spoke a homemade {"tool":...,"args":...} line protocol that no MCP client could talk to, and returned {"status":"executed"} for any unimplemented tool - 22 of the advertised 33 were silent no-ops. Now 29 tools, all backed by real implementations, verified end-to-end with the official MCP client.
local_mcp_store_note: The first version of .mcp.json set MNEM_DATA_DIR=/home/skynas/.memcore. That was wrong: it is a DIFFERENT database from the one the REST API serves, so the client would have answered confidently from stale data. No host path fixes this - the live store is in the container and its volume is root-owned. The bridge proxies to POST /mcp/call instead, so there is exactly one store. No master password needed on the client side.
count_note: Previously documented as 33 MCP tools and '200+' CLI commands. Real numbers are 29 and 60 (28 of the 60 are generated stubs that only print a placeholder). Do not restore the inflated figures.

embeddings_note: sentence-transformers/torch are NOT installed in the container or in .venv, so BGEEmbedder has always fallen back to LocalHashEmbedder while reporting 'bge-small'.
